text:
{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "optics_normal",
      "alarms_cleared",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "older transmission units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "disabling and enabling the interface once",
    "avoid": [
      "sfp.replace",
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Before replacing the SFP again or rebooting the unit, check the traffic counters.  If the interface is UP but the counters remain at zero, try disabling and enabling the interface once.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": true,
    "outcome": "unknown",
    "outcome_excerpt": null,
    "about_entity": "TRN-042"
  },
  "reason": "An expert states a reusable troubleshooting rule for older transmission units where traffic does not recover after SFP replacement despite normal status, optics, and cleared alarms, and counters remain at zero: bounce the interface instead of replacing the SFP again or rebooting."
}
